(6) The girl in the denim dress finds more figures in the bin and shows them to the camera. (7) The video concludes with a pink graphic screen featuring a cartoon character and text.

The sound of plastic toy blocks clattering and clinking against each other creates a persistent percussive layer beneath the voices. (3) The adult woman's voice joins, characterized by a warm, melodic pitch and moderate speech rate. The interaction is punctuated by occasional 'thuds' of toys being dropped.
